args.sql:
WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM complex_oracle.main.sales s
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
)
SELECT * FROM city_sales WHERE sales_2020 >= 1.2 * sales_2019 AND sales_2019 > 0

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as amount_sold
    FROM complex_oracle.main.sales s
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, s.prod_id
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
),
filtered_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_2020 >= 1.2 * sales_2019 AND sales_2019 > 0
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        b.prod_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as prod_sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as prod_sales_2020,
        SUM(b.amount_sold) as prod_total_sales
    FROM base_sales b
    JOIN filtered_cities fc ON b.cust_city = fc.cust_city
    GROUP BY b.prod_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(prod_sales_2019) as total_2019,
        SUM(prod_sales_2020) as total_2020
    FROM product_sales
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        ps.prod_total_sales,
        ps.prod_sales_2019 / qt.total_2019 as share_2019,

        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY ps.prod_total_sales DESC) as sales_rank
    FROM product_sales ps

)
SELECT

FROM product_shares ps
JOIN complex_oracle.main.products p ON ps.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE ps.sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY ps.share_change_pp ASC
